about: Levels and steps in teaching order. Each step lists the letters it introduces; a word belongs to the first step by which all its letters have been introduced. Levels 3 to 6 are placeholders so the format can hold them later.

levels.summary: Short a, then short i; consonants b, c, d, f, g, h, l, m, n, p, r, s, t
Short o, then u, then e; consonants j, k, v, w, x, y, z
sh, ch, th, wh, ck, qu; doubled ff, ll, ss, zz
